sloka: अन्योन्यं लम्बितकरौ ततस्तौ हरिराक्षसौ ।किष्किन्धां विशतुर्हृष्टौ सिंहौ गिरिगुहामिव ।। ७.३४.४३ ॥
transliteration: anyonyaṁ lambitakarau tatastau harirākṣasau ।kiṣkindhāṁ viśaturhṛṣṭau siṁhau giriguhāmiva ।। 7.34.43 ॥

translations.english: Then, those two, the monkey (Vali) and the demon (Ravana), with hands clasped, joyfully entered Kishkindha, just like two lions entering a mountain cave.
